title: Levelwise invertibility of the integral dualizing comparison
statement: For the finite coefficient extension and coherent dualizing data of [def-sf-integral-finite-extension-core], every normalized finite reduction of the canonical comparison u is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Expand u_reduction. The quotient comparison, scalar extension of the source reduction, and inverse target reduction are isomorphisms. The finite-free counit comparison finiteU is invertible at each quotient level, so their composite is invertible; cancel the target reduction isomorphism.
